notes.title: Yogscast Tiny Teams Festival!
notes.content:
We're super excited to announce that this week (9th-15th August) Before I Forget is being showcased as part of the Yogscast Tiny Teams Festival!

We're very proud of our small team and what we have been able to achieve, and feel very humbled to be among so many other great games and developers in the festival! Make sure to check them out here :) ->

https://bit.ly/TinyTeams20
